# Accessibility (AX)

This is the short form. Before writing code in this area, read the full rules with reasons, bad/good examples and checks: `.ui-polish/rules/10-accessibility.md`.

- **AX-01 A visible focus ring on everything focusable** (error). Define a global `:focus-visible` style using the `--ring` token (2px outline, 2px offset) and keep or restate it on every custom control. The ring must have 3:1 contrast against what is behind it and must not be clipped by `overflow: hidden` parents.
- **AX-02 Never remove an outline without replacing it** (error). `outline: none` / `outline-none` is allowed only together with a visible replacement for the focused state: a ring, a border colour change with 3:1 contrast, or a background change on items inside a menu. To hide the ring for mouse users use `:focus:not(:focus-visible)`, never a blanket reset.
- **AX-03 Images have alt text** (error). Every `<img>` has `alt`. Informative images describe their content or function in a short phrase ("Bar chart: revenue up 12% in March"); decorative images use `alt=""` so they are skipped; images inside links or buttons describe the destination or action. Inline SVG icons that are decorative get `aria-hidden="true"`; meaningful ones get `role="img"` and `aria-label`.
- **AX-04 Interactive things are real interactive elements** (error). Anything clickable is a `<button type="button">` (action) or `<a href>` (navigation). Do not attach `onClick` to `<div>`, `<span>`, `<li>`, `<tr>` or `<img>`. To make a whole card or row clickable, put a link or button inside and stretch it with a pseudo-element, or use the row's primary cell link.
- **AX-05 Zoom is never disabled** (error). The viewport meta must not contain `user-scalable=no` or `maximum-scale=1`. The layout must remain usable at 200% browser zoom and with text resized to 200% (use `rem` for font sizes, avoid fixed heights on text containers).
- **AX-06 The document declares its language** (error). `<html lang="…">` is set to the page language (`en`, `en-GB`, `de`, …), with `dir="rtl"` for right-to-left languages. Passages in another language get their own `lang`.
- **AX-07 Icon-only controls have accessible names** (warning). A button or link whose only content is an icon has `aria-label` describing the action and its object ("Delete invoice INV-2041", not "Delete" repeated twenty times; never "icon" or "button"). The icon itself is `aria-hidden`. Pair it with a `Tooltip` showing the same label.
- **AX-08 No positive `tabindex`** (warning). Use `tabindex="0"` to add a custom widget to the tab order and `tabindex="-1"` for programmatic focus only. Never use values of 1 or more. Tab order follows DOM order, so fix the DOM order (and use CSS `order` sparingly, since it desynchronises visual and focus order).
- **AX-09 Contrast meets AA** (error). Body text and text in controls: at least 4.5:1 against its background. Large text (24px, or 18.66px bold and up): 3:1. Non-text essentials (input borders, icons that convey meaning, focus rings, chart lines, the boundary of a toggle): 3:1. Placeholder and disabled text are exempt from the ratio but must still be legible. Check both themes, and check text on tinted surfaces, on images and on the primary colour.
- **AX-10 Everything works from the keyboard** (error). Tab reaches every control in a logical order and never gets trapped except inside an open modal. Enter and Space activate; arrow keys move within composite widgets (menus, tabs, radio groups, listboxes, calendars); Escape closes the topmost overlay. Opening a dialog moves focus into it and traps it; closing returns focus to the element that opened it. Provide a "Skip to content" link as the first focusable element. After a route change or an inline deletion, move focus somewhere sensible.
- **AX-11 Semantic structure before ARIA** (warning). Use landmarks once each where applicable: `<header>`, `<nav aria-label>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`, `<footer>`. Use lists for lists, `<table>` with `<th scope>` and `<caption>` for tabular data, `<button>` and `<a>` for controls, `<fieldset>`/`<legend>` for grouped inputs. Add ARIA only when no element has the semantics, and follow the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices pattern exactly when you do. No `role="button"` on a `<button>`, no `aria-label` on non-interactive `<div>`s.
- **AX-12 Not colour alone; announce changes** (warning). Status is carried by text or an icon plus colour: error fields have a message and icon, required fields say so, chart series differ by label or shape, links inside text are underlined. Dynamic updates are announced: toasts and async results use `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`, errors `role="alert"`; loading regions set `aria-busy`. Do not auto-dismiss messages that contain actions or errors.
